high.evidence: Anonymous replay is required to derive both baselines but cannot know which five secret post-beacon cases to exclude from the 55-case frequency fit.
high.affected_gate: Blinded baseline integrity and executable contract consistency
high.reproduction: Give replay only anonymous inputs: it cannot derive the leave-five-out prior; give it IDs and it violates isolation.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Use a distinct frozen baseline helper after selection, independently recompute its exact 50-case table in the scorer, and keep identities/frequency records unreadable to candidate/replay.

high.evidence: A local manifest fsync/floor does not prove the manifest existed before the chosen drand round; a favorable historical authentic round can be paired with floor=round-1 afterward. Relay equality is not BLS verification.
high.affected_gate: Unbiased post-freeze fixture selection and nonce unpredictability
high.reproduction: Grind historical rounds, write a manifest with the chosen round minus one as floor, and pass the old verifier.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Externally timestamp the exact manifest before the selected round, require one exact next round, verify BLS against a frozen chain key/hash, and reject historical-beacon/later-manifest mutation.
